clips.title: The story
paras: Forest Song is an ancient night elf ruin nestled in northeastern Ashenvale, near the tainted woods of Satyrnaar and the great portal at Bough Shadow. At present, it stands largely deserted save for the vigilant druid Kayneth Stillwind, who watches over the eastern border against emergent threats.

Tucked away in the dense woodlands of northeastern Ashenvale, Forest Song was once an elegant settlement of the kaldorei. Today, white stone columns and crumbling archways are overgrown with ivy and wild ferns. Located northeast of Satyrnaar and just north of the encroaching Warsong Lumber Camp, the ruins hold a quiet, strategic overlook along the eastern trails toward Azshara and Bough Shadow. While the woods around it are plagued by demonic corruption and Horde incursions, the ruin itself maintains a haunting, tranquil stillness.
